about: A fast .NET library for reading and writing Excel files with little memory.

prs.title: Durations from Excel keep their whole seconds
prs.broken: Time lengths read from Excel often came back a hair short, so 11 seconds showed as 10. In one test sheet 1541 of 5600 durations were off.
prs.changed: Durations are now rounded to milliseconds, the same way dates already were.
prs.matters: Reports and imports show the same times Excel shows.
